g.text: Rate: Vc = RATE + 0.45 x RATE CV

g.desc: Rate: Vc = RATE + 0.45 x RATE CV

g.text: Vc = RATE (A10K from 10 V) + 0.45 x RATE CV (U2B, D10: never negative; R22: ~50 mV floor). f = Vc x 245 Hz/V: FAST 13 Hz-2.4 kHz, SLOW (+470 nF) 0.06-11 Hz.

g.desc: Vc = RATE (A10K from 10 V) + 0.45 x RATE CV (U2B, D10: never negative; R22: ~50 mV floor). f = Vc x 245 Hz/V: FAST 13 Hz-2.4 kHz, SLOW (+470 nF) 0.06-11 Hz.

g.text: Panel: J1 pot (1 CCW, 2 wiper, 3 CW); J6 RATE CV jack; J2 RANGE, J5 SHAPE switches (1 A, 2 common, 3 B); J3, J4 jack out; J61 LED pads (1 anode, 2 GND).
